calls.title: 30 min with Scott (Jess Lin)
calls.summary: Growthbook is establishing foundational marketing efforts to effectively position its complex product for technical audiences, especially in preparation for the 4.4 product release. Scott Bailey, the first full marketing hire, is developing core messaging and improving documentation for the managed warehouse solution. The company balances product-led growth with enterprise sales by targeting experimentation teams in larger organizations. Community engagement is emphasized, with direct interactions fostering trust and allowing for valuable feedback. The marketing team is preparing for a new website launch to enhance SEO and user experience while incorporating AI capabilities into its workflows to stay competitive. The company's culture promotes a balanced work environment, enabling employees to tackle diverse technical challenges.
calls.keywords: Developer Advocacy, AI Agents, Technical Product Marketing, Experimentation Platform, Managed Warehouse, Content Creation
calls.action_items:
**Scott Bailey**
Continue foundational positioning and messaging work for GrowthBook’s upcoming 4.4 product release (26:36)
Develop and implement event tracking plan for new website rollout (29:23)

Conduct ongoing customer research interviews to understand AI integration and experimentation workflows (39:48)
